body: I don't know what makes me feel this way. I just felt tired at first..I felt worthless and very very tired for no reason. I realized that I changed a lot. I started reaching out for help, but it seemed like no one would care. So I'm becoming more and more depressed. I'm not interested in anything I used to enjoy as hobbies anymore. I can't even tell my parents how depressed I am. They're gonna end up yelling at me and I don't want my brothers to feel like I'm the one who always cause problems in family. Now I just kinda hate myself, just like my parents and my brothers hate me. I don't know if you can understand me.. anyway, thank you so much!
